input_from_database: the group action, the multidegrees and the invariance of the defining polynomials; GCoh is only the comparison target
method: Gamma-equivariant Koszul resolution resolved by node: every H^q is the sum of the E1 terms with q - p equal to that degree, valid whenever the complex collapses by bidegree support. Resolves H^1 and H^2 separately, so the vector-like sector is determined too.
